Ravi S: Heads-up — saw a sustained preview vs final mismatch for tenant acme-staging between 11:22 and 11:30 UTC (~48% preview > final).
Claire M: Oof. Any recent routing changes or rollout?
Ravi S: Ops rotated a handful of edge hosts during an autoscale at 11:20. Not huge, but saw sticky-session TTL drop from 5m -> 30s in the config.
Ben T: Ah that explains it. Our preview pipeline dedupes on session_fingerprint which includes sticky_session_id. If TTL expires quickly, the same logical session looks like two sessions and preview emits duplicate token rows. Final ledger dedupe uses req_id later so it collapses correctly.
Ravi S: We also saw a jump in route_resolve latency which may have re-assigned requests mid-session.
metering-bot: metric: billing.preview_delta_pct{tenant="acme-staging"} = 48.2
Claire M: Short term: can Ops revert sticky-session TTL to 5m for that pool?
ops-bot: action: pin-sticky-ttl pool=us-west-2b ttl=300s requested_by=@Claire M ETA=6m
Ben T: Medium term proposals: (A) prefer X-Request-Id for early dedupe when present; (B) compute a cheap session_stability_score and only emit preview rows when score>threshold; (C) add a payload_hash fallback computed only when req_id missing.
Ravi S: I like session_stability_score — we can derive from last_route_change_ts, generated_client_header presence, and sticky_ttl. Low score -> mark preview row as provisional and don't surface in invoice-preview totals.
Claire M: That would reduce noise for support and curb false-positive billing alerts. We should also show the provisional badge in the console next to tenant totals.
Ben T: Telemetry: we need counters for events where session_fingerprint changed within 2s and for events where generated-client header was used. Also expose histogram of session_stability_score.
metering-bot: log: preview_rows_emitted{tenant="acme-staging", provisional=true} = 412 over 10m
Ravi S: UX: console change request — add a "Preview confidence" indicator ("Low/Medium/High") with a hover tooltip linking to runbook and last egress change. Support keeps filing tickets without this context.
Claire M: +1. Add a one-line blurb: "Preview may be incomplete/unreliable if edge routing or sticky sessions changed recently." Link to runbook. Keep it collapsible.
Ben T: Performance concern: computing payload_hash for all requests is too expensive at 50k QPS. We'll gate payload_hash behind a feature flag and compute only when req_id is absent or session_stability_score is low.
Ravi S: Plan: 1) Ops pin TTL now (done), 2) implement session_stability_score and provisional preview rows (feature-flagged), 3) shadow mode for 2h in prod, 4) enable for 10% tenants, 5) console badge & alert tweak.
ops-bot: done: sticky-ttl pinned for pool=us-west-2b by @ops-team
Claire M: Create followups: INC-5002 (customer outreach & adjustment), PR-6142 (session_stability + provisional flag), DASH-199 (console confidence indicator), MET-88 (telemetry counters).
Ben T: I'll draft PR-6142 and include a lightweight Python pseudocode snippet in the description for reviewers.
Ravi S: Also add an alert mute rule while we run the shadow so customers don't get paged: mute preview_delta alerts for flagged tenants during canary.
metering-bot: alert: preview_delta_pct{tenant="acme-staging"} > 40% auto-ack=false
Claire M: I'll own customer comms once INC-5002 is created. Thanks team.
Ben T: Quick note for rollout checklist: avoid sticky-ttl drops during autoscale, coordinate egress changes with metering team. Add to Runbook v3.
Ravi S: Closing loop — TTL pin succeeded, shadow work started, follow-ups filed. We'll reconvene after shadow metrics in 2h.
